name: co-hoc-ly-thuyet-static-reader
description: Dev-only QA scripts for the offline mechanics textbook reader.

scripts.test:search: python -m unittest tests/test_search_index_build.py && node tests/search-performance.test.js && playwright test tests/search-runtime.spec.js
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run validate:traceability && python tools/build_acceptance_report.py && node tests/acceptance-report-contract.test.js
scripts.test:acceptance-bundle: python -m unittest tests.test_acceptance_bundle tests.test_release_candidate tests.test_release_smoke_review tests.test_qa_evidence_capture
scripts.test:media-pilot: npm run validate:media-pilot && node --test tests/media-pilot-manifest.test.js && playwright test tests/media-pilot-browser.spec.js
scripts.test:accessibility: playwright test tests/accessibility-axe.spec.js tests/accessibility-landmarks.spec.js tests/accessibility-keyboard-flows.spec.js tests/accessibility-zoom-reflow.spec.js tests/accessibility-contrast.spec.js
scripts.test:content-manifest: node tests/content-manifest-schema.test.js && node tests/content-manifest-route-parity.test.js && node tests/release-manifest-contract.test.js && node tests/release-baseline-contract.test.js
scripts.test:pdf:release: npm run test:pdf:vendor && npm run test:pdf:transport && npm run test:pdf:browser && npm run test:pdf:installed && npm run test:sim:release && npm run test:sim3:pilot
scripts.test:sim:contracts: node tests/sim2-animation-clock.test.js && node tests/simulation-route-truth.test.js && node tests/sim2-route-coverage.test.js && node tests/simulation-release-scripts.test.js
scripts.test:sim:physics: npm run test:sim:contracts && npm run test:sim:route-physics && node tests/sim2-physics-port.test.js && node tests/sim2-transform.test.js && node tests/sim2-ch1-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-ch2-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-ch3-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-visual-physics-regression.test.js && node tests/sim2-no-legacy-physics.test.js && node tests/sim2-removal-guard.test.js
scripts.test:sim:visual:unit: node tests/simulation-console-policy.test.js && node tests/sim2-visual-capture-plan.test.js && node tests/sim2-visual-contact-sheet.test.js && node tests/sim2-visual-capture-validation.test.js
scripts.test:sim:mount: playwright test tests/sim2-responsive-accessibility.spec.js tests/sim2-ui-components.spec.js tests/sim2-visual-motion-polish.spec.js tests/sim2-ui-coverage.spec.js tests/sim2-route-domain.spec.js tests/sim2-ch1-mount.spec.js tests/sim2-ch1-integration.spec.js tests/sim2-ch2-mount.spec.js tests/sim2-ch3-mount.spec.js tests/sim2-mount-robustness.spec.js tests/content-only-smoke.spec.js
scripts.test:app: playwright test tests/content-width-preference.spec.js tests/progress-single-source.spec.js tests/notes-indicator-refresh.spec.js tests/loader-sim-mount-baseid.spec.js tests/quiz-empty-result-cache.spec.js

scripts.test:sim:release: npm run test:sim:physics && npm run test:sim:mount && npm run test:app && npm run test:content && npm run test:quiz && npm run test:sim:production && npm run test:sim:lifecycle && npm run test:sim:responsive && npm run test:sim3:pilot && npm run test:sim:visual:unit && npm run test:sim:probe:unit

scripts.test:sim:release:soak: npm run test:sim:release && npm run test:sim:release && npm run test:sim:release
scripts.test:sim:probe:unit: node tests/sim-probe-delta.test.js && node tests/sim-probe-a-logic.test.js && node tests/sim-probe-b-sign.test.js && node tests/sim-probe-validation.test.js
scripts.test:sim3:pilot: npm run test:sim3:coordinates && npm run test:sim3:core && playwright test tests/sim3-pilot-fallback-dispose.spec.js
scripts.test:equations: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Get-ChildItem scripts/test-phase-*.py | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Host \"=== $($_.Name) ===\"; & python $_.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 } }"
